m2b_interpretation.pass_means: The synchronized M2 decision tape is engineering-valid under the corrected independently preregistered replay-size validation method.

parent.m2_failure_cause: Latest size-bearing TOB was an invalid endpoint size ground truth after later same-level deltas.

primary_checkpoint_test.pair_definition: Consecutive H2-v2 full-book snapshots for the same target token within the engineering window.
primary_checkpoint_test.purpose: Independently validate exact price-level and size replay semantics.

replay_rule.base: Start from every price/size level in the earlier full-book snapshot.
replay_rule.comparison: After replay, normalized complete bid and ask maps must exactly equal the checkpoint ws_book maps, including every non-zero price level and exact Decimal size.

delta_semantics.B: size > 0 sets/replaces bid level; size = 0 removes it
delta_semantics.S: size > 0 sets/replaces ask level; size = 0 removes it

replay_rule.generation: Replay only deltas with the same book_generation as base and checkpoint.
replay_rule.rest_base: Checkpoint connection_id defines the WS continuation. Replay same-generation deltas on that connection with capture_time > base.capture_time and ingest_sequence < checkpoint.ingest_sequence.
replay_rule.ws_base: Base and checkpoint must share connection_id. Replay deltas on that connection with base.ingest_sequence < delta.ingest_sequence < checkpoint.ingest_sequence.

secondary_diagnostic_only.generation_boundary_pairs: May be reported separately but cannot determine M2b PASS/FAIL because REST checkpoint timing is asynchronous to WS ordering.

window.end: maximum decision_time among eligible run-11691 anchors + 500ms
window.start: minimum decision_time among eligible run-11691 anchors
